measurement_basis: committed event-correlation improvement linked to prior authenticated pressure evidence and focused verification

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment authority denial and integration-eligibility projection

outcome.implementation_change: The existing activity projection now relates a structured overlapping-claim denial to the earliest later eligible preflight in the selected event window when repository, action, and claim identity match. The relation carries the later event reference, keeps operation_executed false, and states that causal resolution is not established.
outcome.effectiveness_assessment: projection relationship and regression tests verified; operational effectiveness not assessed
outcome.analysis_limit: The authentic campaign history contains the denial and later preflight events, but the preflight event retained at most eight of seventeen overlap references. The old readback does not establish whether this exact claim was in that bounded set, and no live post-change projection was available to determine whether the relationship can be reconstructed from the canonical history.
